audit.whatIsWrong: diff read EVEN at 5.5/10 while the lane is 54.49% over 3439 games and the chart gives Darius every stage up to two items.
audit.why: An even label on one of Darius's better top-lane matchups tells the reader to play it more carefully than the data supports.
audit.corrected: FAV at 4/10; carry threat left at 6/10 because Sion's late-game frontline value is real.

audit.whatIsWrong: win[1] said Skill, win[2], win[3] and win[5] said Sion, with the matching phases sides — but whys[1], whys[2], whys[3] and whys[5] all describe Darius stages, and the packet chart reads Darius x6 then Sion.
audit.why: Four of seven rows contradicted their own explanations and the packet.
audit.corrected: Levels 2, 3, 4-5 and First item flipped to Darius; 2+ items stays Sion.

audit.whatIsWrong: Soul Furnace (W) can be reactivated three seconds after it goes up to detonate for magic damage, and Roar of the Slayer (E) shreds armour and knocks a minion back through you. Neither is stated, and the content layer never names a Sion ability (packet defect). Nothing warns that a landed Unstoppable Onslaught knocks you up, which takes Noxian Guillotine away for the duration.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Sion shields himself and can reactivate after 3 seconds to deal Magic Damage to enemies nearby'; 'reduces the Armor of the first enemy hit… if the shockwave hits a minion… it will be knocked back'. The three-second arm time is what makes 'break the shield first' actionable.
audit.corrected: All three written in, with Soul Furnace 15s, Roar of the Slayer 12s and Decimating Smash 10s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Glory in Death heals Sion off his attacks while he is reanimated, and those attacks scale with your max health — nothing tells you to have Grievous Wounds up before you kill him.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'His attacks become very rapid, heal him, and deal bonus damage based on his target's maximum Health.' Stacking HP against that is the wrong answer and anti-heal is the right one.

edits.before: Sion's whole kit is telegraphed — sidestep the Q knockup channel, walk out of E, then E Apprehend him and dump full Hemorrhage while he has no reset.
edits.after: Sion is telegraphed — sidestep the Decimating Smash charge (10s), walk out of Roar of the Slayer, then Apprehend him and dump Hemorrhage while he has nothing back.

edits.before: R Noxian Guillotine executes him at five stacks before his passive rez even matters much — and you can ult again off any minion to dodge his ramming R.
edits.after: R executes him at five stacks, but Glory in Death reanimates him and those attacks heal him off your max health — hold Grievous Wounds up before you take the kill.

edits.before: Sion pokes with Q and W shield but has no way to punish you if you respect the charge; last-hit under tower and poke with Q Decimate.
edits.after: Sion pokes with Decimating Smash and Soul Furnace, which detonates three seconds after he casts it; last-hit safely and trade before that window.

edits.before: - Sion Decimating Smash (Stun): matchup-defining — Charged = knockup. Sidestep it. Darius E (Apprehend): Long early cooldown. Never throw this out predictably; save it explicitly to interrupt their dash trajectories mid-flight or catch their retreat paths. Darius Ghost: Your primary lethal enabler. Keep this tool ready to completely blow through ranged poke or instant slows across the lane.
edits.after: - Sion Decimating Smash (Stun): matchup-defining — 10s at rank 1, and only a full charge knocks up. Sidestep it, then commit. - Soul Furnace: 15s, and he can detonate it three seconds after it goes up — trade before that or after. - Roar of the Slayer: 12s, shreds your armour and knocks a minion back through you. - Apprehend: 26s at rank 1 — hold it for the moment his charge whiffs, and keep Ghost for the run-down.

edits.before: Your committal tool is the lane — burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Soul Furnace detonates three seconds after he casts it — trade before that window, not into it.

notes: Soul Furnace's three-second arm time is the whole trade clock in this lane and appeared nowhere; the entry said 'break his furnace shield before it can detonate' without ever saying how long you have. Chart was wrong in four of seven rows against both the whys and the packet, and the entry was labelled EVEN on a 54.49% lane. UNVERIFIED and deliberately not written: tldr claims your pull 'reactively cancels his heavy Q smash channels'. Apprehend is a displacement and Decimating Smash is a charge-up, so it is plausible, but Riot's text does not say the charge is interruptible and champ-data marks animation cancels unknown — it needs a wiki check before anyone leans on it. Same for sion.json's 'terrain' flag on Unstoppable Onslaught, which Riot's description does not support; I wrote only the knockup, which does take Guillotine away while you are airborne.
